verification_categories_derived_from_spe: PDU minimum cases — FC 0x07 Read Exception Status (no data), FC 0x0B Get Comm Event Counter (no data).
PDU maximum cases — FC 0x10 Write Multiple Registers with quantity = 123 (= 246 byte payload, 253-byte PDU).
ADU framing — RTU: Address + PDU + CRC ≤ 256 B; ASCII: ':' + 2N hex + LRC + CR LF; TCP: 7 B MBAP + PDU ≤ 260 B.
PDU-vs-user-address offset — verify that a user-facing register 1 lives at PDU address 0x0000.
Big-endian on wire — write 0x1234 to a Holding Register; first wire byte = 0x12.
Per-FC quantity boundaries — FC 0x01/0x02: 1 and 2000; FC 0x03/0x04: 1 and 125; FC 0x0F: 1 and 1968; FC 0x10: 1 and 123; FC 0x17 read 1..125 + write 1..121; FC 0x18 returned ≤ 31.
FC 0x05 Output Value enum — only 0xFF00 / 0x0000 accepted; other values → exception 0x03.
FC 0x16 Mask Write Register — verify Result = (Current AND AND_Mask) OR (OR_Mask AND (NOT AND_Mask)). Reference example: Current 0x0012, AND 0x00F2, OR 0x0025 → Result 0x0017.
FC 0x17 atomic read+write — single transaction performs the write first, then the read; results reflect the post-write state.
FC 0x18 Read FIFO Queue — fifo_count ≤ 31; byte_count = fifo_count*2 + 2.
FC 0x14 / 0x15 multi-sub-request file record access; Byte Count bounds the per-PDU payload at 252 B.
Exception 0x01 ILLEGAL FUNCTION — send an unsupported FC.
Exception 0x02 ILLEGAL DATA ADDRESS — Address + Quantity outside table; spec example (Section 7): 100-register controller, address 96 + quantity 5 fails since register 100 doesn't exist.
Exception 0x03 ILLEGAL DATA VALUE — Quantity > limit; FC 0x05 Output Value ∉ {0xFF00, 0x0000}.
Exception 0x04 SERVER DEVICE FAILURE — internal error simulator.
Exception 0x05 ACKNOWLEDGE — long-running programming command.
Exception 0x06 SERVER DEVICE BUSY — second long command while first is running.
Exception 0x08 MEMORY PARITY ERROR — file-record area consistency error.
Exception 0x0A / 0x0B — gateway misconfigured / target unresponsive.
Broadcast (RTU/ASCII Address = 0) — server processes request, no response.
Serial RTU CRC error — flip one bit; server silently discards; Bus Communication Error Count++.
Serial ASCII LRC error — flip one hex char; same silent discard.
RTU T3.5 silence — verify end-of-frame detected only after sufficient silence; intra-frame T1.5 silence tolerated.
ASCII intra-frame timing — long inter-character pauses tolerated; only ':' and CR LF mark frame boundaries.
TCP MBAP.Protocol_ID = 0x0000 enforcement.
TCP MBAP.Transaction_ID echo — server response carries the same Transaction_ID as the matching request.
TCP pipelined transactions — send Request_1 then Request_2 on same socket without waiting; verify responses match by Transaction_ID.
TCP MBAP.Length consistency — Length = 1 + len(PDU); mismatch handling.
Diagnostics — Force Listen Only Mode (sub 0x0004) enters silent state; Restart Communications Option (sub 0x0001) exits.

Diagnostic counters — Bus Message Count, Bus Comm Error Count, Bus Exception Error Count, Server Message Count, Server No Response Count, Server NAK Count, Server Busy Count, Bus Character Overrun Count.

Read Device Identification (FC 0x2B / MEI 14) — Basic conformity level: mandatory objects 0x00 VendorName, 0x01 ProductCode, 0x02 MajorMinorRevision; Regular / Extended / Specific access modes (Read Device ID codes 01..04).
CANopen General Reference (FC 0x2B / MEI 13) — opaque payload per CiA documentation.
Reserved-FC rejection — verify the server returns 0x01 ILLEGAL FUNCTION when sent FC 9, 10, 13, 14, 41, 42, 90, 91, 125..127.
fields.notes: The MODBUS V1.1b3 spec embeds per-function-code state diagrams (Figures 11..16) that implicitly define the verification surface for each FC. There is no Modbus.org-published testbench or compliance certification — Modbus.org references a separate 'available conformance test' for Public function codes but does not include it in this document.
